messages:
Lena: hi everyone, lena here (platform ui)  second day! i'm blocked by a 403 when attempting to flip a console feature flag for a quick prod repro: POST /admin/flags/limit-guest-checkout/enable. who owns short-lived prod access or the JIT flow?

Marco: welcome @Lena :wave: we keep prod flag edits gated. do you need full toggle rights or just a temporary window to flip+revert?

Lena: just a 1hr window to reproduce a customer issue and then revert. i tried via the UI and got a generic 403 with no hint.

Tess: I can sponsor a JIT for you. please link the ticket and add a one-line justification. Ops will enforce MFA when approving.

Lena: ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PROD-4112  reason: reproduce guest checkout failure in prod when flag is off.

security-bot: JIT request logged: JIT-2026-4112 requested by Lena. Approver: Tess. Review link: https://console.redwood.ai/jit/JIT-2026-4112

Marco: if the JIT is delayed, ping @oncall for a manual 2-hour ff-temp-admin add. manual adds are only used for urgent debug windows.

Tess: approving now. note for newbies: always paste the curl or UI steps you used in the ticket so auditing is clean.

security-bot: JIT approved: JIT-2026-4112. Lena granted ff-temp-admin for 60 minutes. Audit ref: audit-2026-03-22-02

Lena: thanks! for debugging record, here's the command i ran (got 403 before approval):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags/limit-guest-checkout/enable
```
response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","code":"FF_NO_ACCESS"}

Lena: able to toggle now, repro'ed issue, reverted flag at T+40m. added timestamps and audit id to the ticket.

oncall: thanks for the quick revert and ticket notes. follow-up: file a small smoke test in staging that mirrors this flag so we avoid prod-only repros.

Tess: welcome aboard @Lena. Pro tip: for future investigations ask for a canary percent rollout if you just need sample traffic rather than full toggle. saves blast radius.

Lena: will do, thanks all! excited to be here :smile:
